svg.text: 一个共同的场景：路氹城生态保护区的泥滩
One shared scene: the Cotai mudflat
布的宽度就是这条剖面，长度是时间，一纬十五分钟。
The cloth’s width is this transect. Its length is time, 15 minutes a pick.
同一条剖面，按关键带重读。从树冠到地下水的一层薄壳。不是测绘图。
The same cut, read as the critical zone. The thin layer from canopy to groundwater.
观众不是一个圈层。人从一个小口进入。
Humans are not a sphere. They enter as visitors.
2004 年起，澳门唯一的国际重要鸟区
An Important Bird Area since 2004. Macau’s only one.
2026 年全球普查，已由濒危降为易危
Worldwide count, 2026. Downlisted from Endangered to Vulnerable.
The show opens in their arrival season.
事实来自新华社，2026 年 6 月 5 日。 Facts: Xinhua, 5 June 2026.
